t_carpet_concrete_green_olight.name: industrial green carpet
t_carpet_concrete_green_olight.description: Firm, low-pile, high-durability carpet in a green color, for laying down on bare concrete, with a still-functioning light attached to the ceiling above.

t_lixa_wall.name: reinforced concrete wall
t_lixa_wall.description: An extremely resilient wall, filled with concrete and rebar.  Best suited for supporting multi-level buildings, only serious explosives and high-speed impacts would be capable of damaging this wall.

t_folded_wall.name: folded wall
t_folded_wall.description: When looked at out of the side of the eye, this wall seems to bend and curve in on itself and when looked at head on it seems to be a repeating pattern of solid concrete hexagons.

t_unfolded_wall.name: unfolded wall
t_unfolded_wall.description: This wall tessellates as you view it.

t_infinite_shaft_rooved.name: open air
t_infinite_shaft_rooved.description: An area of open air in what appears to be a shaft extending into the depths of the earth.  You cannot understand how or why someone would build an elevator shaft going into the depths of the earth like this for reasons other than mining.  It's bottom, if there is one, seems to be far past where light penetrates.

names: Climb down by lowering yourself from the ledge.
Can't jump across (need a small gap).
effect.title: There is a ledge here.  What do you want to do?
descriptions: You look down as far as you can see.
You hang off the ledge to get closer to a bottom you cannot see.
Take a leap of faith.
End it all.

t_LIXA_tube.name: laser chamber
t_LIXA_tube.description: A large section of metal tubing, balanced on spring supports to prevent any vibration from affecting the laser inside.

t_LIXA_portal_pulse.name: spatial compressor
t_LIXA_portal_pulse.description: A dizzyingly complex series of devices and readouts is on the outside of this machine's casing.  You imagine the inside would be incomprehensible.

t_LIXA_unfolded_portal_pulse.name: fractal compressor
t_LIXA_unfolded_portal_pulse.description: This space is infinite, and has no beginning or end.  But you can see both right here, in this churning mass of angles.

t_LIXA_unfolded_tube.name: unfolded laser chamber
t_LIXA_unfolded_tube.description: You can see the inside surface of this tube, and what it contains.  Thick, slimy red light oozes within it.

bash.sound: a hollow pop, followed by a sickly wet squelching as congealed light slowly leaks out of the tube.

t_LIXA_unfolded_tube_broken.name: leaking laser chamber
t_LIXA_unfolded_tube_broken.description: Gobbets of congealed light drip from the gash in the side of this chamber like hot marmalade.

t_LIXA_thconc_floor.name: concrete floor
t_LIXA_thconc_floor.description: You can see every side of every crack in this worn concrete, all the way down.  You can't look at it for too long.

t_LIXA_strconc_wall.name: reinforced concrete wall
t_LIXA_strconc_wall.description: You can see every side of every crack in this worn concrete, all the way down.  You can't look at it for too long.

t_LIXA_laser.description: A huge casing for a device that generates and focuses a laser of an incredibly precise wavelength.

t_nl_mist.name: swirling mist
t_nl_mist.description: A swirling, exotic pattern of shapes, floating in an ill-defined darkness.  Staring at it too long hurts your brain.

t_nl_chasm.name: sparkling chasm
t_nl_chasm.description: At a glance this just looks like darkness.  Then, gazing deeper, you think it might be full of stars.  Still deeper, perhaps those stars are eyes?

effect.title: There is a ledge here.  What do you want to do?

t_nl_obelisk_mission_boiler.name: Obelisk
t_nl_obelisk_mission_boiler.description: A tall, drab grey, metallic pillar covered in swirling patterns.  You could Examine it closer to try and discern the shapes.

effect.u_message: The obelisk is inert.

You see a tall, drab grey, metallic pillar covered in swirling patterns.  As you focus on it, the patterns take the shape of a face, its features clouded by fractal overlays.  It speaks to you, booming loudly as if from some distant place:

 Hear this: a source of power was found in this place.
 Seek it out.  Retrieve it.
 Its power will be YOURS.
 A terminal marks its location.
 The terminal will anchor the rhythm of the object.
 Activate the terminal.
 And you,
 and that which will then be bound to you,
 will be carried home.

t_nl_obelisk_mission_water_cooler.name: Obelisk
t_nl_obelisk_mission_water_cooler.description: A tall, cerulean-blue, metallic pillar covered in swirling patterns.  You could Examine it closer to try and discern the shapes.

effect.u_message: The obelisk is inert.

t_nl_mission_water_cooler.name: bulbous water tank
t_nl_mission_water_cooler.description: This would almost look like an earthly water cooler, except the base is made up of cobbled together scrap metal, and the tank is a clouded fishbowl of green liquid.  Where the tap would be is a very thin, sharp spike, which feeds a dribble-tube that might flow into the tank itself.

t_nl_door_l.name: mysterious locked door
t_nl_door_l.description: A dark door of twisted metal, etched with symbols and writing that you can't piece together.  It appears to be locked.

prying.message: With great effort, you pry open the door.

prying_data.failure: You pry, but it seems like your tools will give out before the door does.

t_nl_door_c.name: mysterious closed door
t_nl_door_c.description: A dark door of twisted metal, etched with symbols and writing that you can't piece together.

t_nl_door_o.name: mysterious open door
t_nl_door_o.description: A dark door of twisted metal, etched with symbols and writing that you can't piece together.  It has been swung open.

t_nl_archway.name: mysterious archway
t_nl_archway.description: A heavy metal archway, etched with alien symbols.

t_nl_archway_scarlet.name: mysterious archway
t_nl_archway_scarlet.description: A heavy metal archway, etched with alien symbols.

t_nl_safehouse_door_metal_corrugated_o.name: open corrugated metal door
t_nl_safehouse_door_metal_corrugated_o.description: A thin, frameless door made of corrugated steel, flimsily attached to the wall.  You think it could be smashed down with a bit of effort, with no risk to the surrounding structure.

t_nl_safehouse_door_metal_corrugated_c.name: closed corrugated metal door
t_nl_safehouse_door_metal_corrugated_c.description: A thin, frameless door made of corrugated steel, flimsily attached to the wall.  You think it could be smashed down with a bit of effort, with no risk to the surrounding structure

t_nl_metal_wall.name: metallic wall
t_nl_metal_wall.description: A durable wall of ordinary looking sheet metal, at first.  Staring closer, the welds and joins seem to form strange fractal patterns.

t_nl_safehouse_metal_wall.name: metallic wall
t_nl_safehouse_metal_wall.description: A durable wall of sheet metal, unnaturally hard and cool to the touch.  It seems to lack any rivets, welds, or other connections.

t_nl_safehouse_metal_wall_wired.name: metallic wall
t_nl_safehouse_metal_wall_wired.description: A durable wall of sheet metal, unnaturally hard and cool to the touch.  It is covered in removable panels, which conceal well-organized pipes and wires.  Otherwise, the wall itself lacks any rivets, welds, or other connections.

t_nl_safehouse_metal_wall_wired_destruct.name: metallic wall
t_nl_safehouse_metal_wall_wired_destruct.description: A durable wall of sheet metal.  It is covered in removable panels, which conceal well-organized pipes and wires.  It also has several obvious rivet points that make it look like it could be removed with a bit of effort, with no risk to the surrounding structure.

t_nl_metal_wall_border.name: metallic wall
t_nl_metal_wall_border.description: A durable wall of ordinary looking sheet metal, at first.  Staring closer, the welds and joins seem to form strange fractal patterns.

t_nl_scrap_wall.name: scrap metal wall
t_nl_scrap_wall.description: A relatively simple wall made of cobbled-together scrap metal.  The wires and bolts holding it together seem to be in just slightly different configurations whenever you look back at it.

t_nl_metal_floor.name: metallic floor
t_nl_metal_floor.description: Diamond-treaded metallic flooring.  Something seems off about the diamond tread; you keep imagining that the bumps spell out words, but when you look closer they're in very ordinary patterns.

t_nl_broken_metal_floor.name: broken metal floor
t_nl_broken_metal_floor.description: Something has cratered this metal flooring.  It will be difficult to move things across.  Through the cracks and dents emanates a faint eery glow.

t_nl_scrap_floor.name: scrap metal floor
t_nl_scrap_floor.description: A floor assembled from various scraps of metal.  Though their placement seems random, you keep seeing spots where they form faces.

t_nl_catwalk.name: catwalk
t_nl_catwalk.description: This catwalk extends over a deep chasm of swirling shadow.

t_nl_roof.name: swirling metal roof
t_nl_roof.description: A section of sturdy metal roofing that seems to swirl and twist with an unfamiliar, ever-shifting pattern.

t_nl_gates_mech_control.name: rotary lever
t_nl_gates_mech_control.description: A heavy-duty metal lever with two settings.

t_nl_stairs_up.name: mysterious stairs
t_nl_stairs_up.description: A tightly wound spiral staircase vanishing into the depths above.

t_nl_stairs_up_false.name: mysterious stairs
t_nl_stairs_up_false.description: A tightly wound spiral staircase going up.  However, it stops at the ceiling, perfectly flush with it, as if it were supposed to go up, but couldn't.

t_nl_stairs_down.name: mysterious stairs
t_nl_stairs_down.description: A tightly wound spiral staircase vanishing into the depths below.

t_nl_water_pool.name: black water
t_nl_water_pool.description: A very deep pool full of salty water.  Gentle waves lap against each other in vaguely musical melodies.

t_nl_bridge.name: walkway
t_nl_bridge.description: A metallic bridge commonly used in industrial settings to meet specified safety standards.  The tempered, latticed metal seems to have a different pattern each time you glance at it.

t_nl_sewage_pipe.name: high gauge pipe
t_nl_sewage_pipe.description: A section of high gauge pipe, but covered in holes.  It would clearly be useless to carry liquids.

t_nl_sewage_pipe_border.name: high gauge pipe
t_nl_sewage_pipe_border.description: A massive section of high gauge pipe.  Every few meters the pipe-fittings holding it together rotate in jittery motion.

t_nl_metal_wall_overgrown.name: overgrown metal wall
t_nl_metal_wall_overgrown.description: A durable wall of sheet metal with fractal welds and joins.  All manner of strange, plastic-like plants are poking their way through the crevices.  The plants glow and hum like old, dim fluorescent lights.

t_nl_metal_floor_overgrown.name: overgrown metallic floor
t_nl_metal_floor_overgrown.description: Flooring made of rectangular metal tiles.  Something seems off about the spaces between; you keep imagining that the gaps spell out words, but when you look closer they're in very ordinary patterns.  Beyond that, small blades of glowing, plastic grass are forcing their way through the cracks.

t_nl_metal_floor_grass.name: cybergrass
t_nl_metal_floor_grass.description: An area of metallic flooring covered in bladed, plastic grass, about ankle high.  The blades are softly glowing.

t_nl_metal_floor_grass_long.name: long cybergrass
t_nl_metal_floor_grass_long.description: An area of shattered metallic flooring and dirt covered in long, shaggy, plastic grass about shin high.  The blades are softly glowing.  They move on their own, angling away from things that disturb them.

t_nl_metal_floor_grass_tall.name: tall cybergrass
t_nl_metal_floor_grass_tall.description: An area of shattered metallic flooring and dirt covered in tall, plastic grass, about head high.  The long blades glow and hum like old, dim fluorescent lights.

t_nl_grass.name: cybergrass
t_nl_grass.description: An area of shining dirt covered in bladed, plastic grass, about ankle high.  The blades are softly glowing.

t_nl_grass_long.name: long cybergrass
t_nl_grass_long.description: An area of shining dirt covered in long, shaggy, plastic grass about shin high.  The blades are softly glowing.  They move on their own, angling away from things that disturb them.

t_nl_grass_tall.name: tall cybergrass
t_nl_grass_tall.description: An area of shining dirt covered in tall, plastic grass, about head high.  The long blades glow and hum like old, dim fluorescent lights.

t_nl_soil.name: solid earth
t_nl_soil.description: A wall of solid earth, you think, but full of small, sparkling grains, which seem to twist at the edge of your vision.

t_nl_rock.name: mysterious cavern wall
t_nl_rock.description: A wall of solid rock, or is it?  Despite its color and surface topology, it bares the striations and density of petrified wood.

t_nl_rock_floor.name: mysterious cavern
t_nl_rock_floor.description: A relatively flat area of rock and stone, or is it?  Despite its color and surface topology, it bares the striations and density of petrified wood.

t_nl_dirt.name: sparkling dirt
t_nl_dirt.description: It's dirt, you think, but full of small, sparkling grains, which seem to twist at the edge of your vision.

t_nl_shrub_glowberries.name: glowberry bush
t_nl_shrub_glowberries.description: This lifelike plant seems to be entirely made of plastic.  At its base are copper wires, whirled and gnarled like roots.  It glows softly, like a dim fluorescent bulb.  Despite its otherworldly nature, very real looking berries are hanging from the stems.

t_nl_shrub_glowberries_harvested.name: glowberry bush
t_nl_shrub_glowberries_harvested.description: At first glance this appears to be a simple bush, but closer inspection reveals that the plant seems to be entirely plastic, but of the most realistic design you have ever seen.  It glows softly, like a dim fluorescent bulb.

t_nl_obelisk_mission_utility_space.name: Metal stele
t_nl_obelisk_mission_utility_space.description: A floor to ceiling, shining column.  A massive face with a gaping jaw is cast upon it.  Inside the mouth are several pre-fabricated slots.

t_sunkenhelicopter_roof.name: waterlogged roof

t_sunkenhelicopter_rotor.name: waterlogged heavy-duty military Blackhawk rotors
t_sunkenhelicopter_rotor.description: A set of four military-grade helicopter rotor blades, used to provide lift by rotation.  It has started to degrade after some time spent underwater.  Absolutely unrecoverable.

t_alien_meadow_grass.name: alien grass
t_alien_meadow_grass.description: An area of something that vaguely resembles grass, except it's a light reddish color and the stalks are much broader.  Some kind of waxy residue seems to rub off onto your clothes when you walk through it.

t_alien_meadow_grass_long.name: long alien grass
t_alien_meadow_grass_long.description: An area of something that vaguely resembles grass.  Dark red in color and almost waist-high, each stalk splits into two to four other stalks which similarly split on various places along their length, ending in fine fern-like fronds.

t_alien_meadow_tree_trap_roots_long_gras.name: long alien grass
t_alien_meadow_tree_trap_roots_long_gras.description: An area of something that vaguely resembles grass.  Dark red in color and almost waist-high, each stalk splits into two to four other stalks which similarly split on various places along their length, ending in fine fern-like fronds.

t_alien_meadow_grass_tall.name: tall alien grass
t_alien_meadow_grass_tall.description: An area of something that vaguely resembles grass.  Head high and such a dark red as to be nearly black, the ends of the long stalks are a burst of fine fronds all tangled into and around each other, forming a canopy.

t_alien_meadow_tree_trap_roots_tall_gras.name: tall alien grass
t_alien_meadow_tree_trap_roots_tall_gras.description: An area of something that vaguely resembles grass.  Dark red in color and almost waist-high, each stalk splits into two to four other stalks which similarly split on various places along their length, ending in fine fern-like fronds.

t_alien_meadow_shrub_1.name: alien bush
t_alien_meadow_shrub_1.description: An alien plant, dark blue-green in color.  The leaves are all interwoven, forming a sphere except for spots where the leaves have been eaten away by some predator or pathogen.  It glows faintly in the dark.

t_alien_meadow_shrub_2.name: alien bush
t_alien_meadow_shrub_2.description: An alien bush, but one that looks very similar to a terrestrial bush despite the dark purple leaves.  There are even clusters of white berries growing from it.

t_alien_meadow_shrub_2_harvested.name: alien bush
t_alien_meadow_shrub_2_harvested.description: An alien bush, but one that looks very similar to a terrestrial bush despite the dark purple leaves.

t_alien_meadow_shrub_3.name: alien shrub
t_alien_meadow_shrub_3.description: An alien plant.  The branches split and split again into very fine tendrils with bulbs on the end that float upward, holding its yellow leaves(?) up to the sun.  Every gust of wind makes the entire plant sway.

t_alien_meadow_tree_1.name: alien tree
t_alien_meadow_tree_1.description: An alien tree, a group of individual dark-colored trunks that intertwine to the point whether you can't tell whether it's a single plant or a group of them.  The branches have nodes of dark red leaves interspersed along their lengths.  You're not entirely sure it's moving with the wind.

t_alien_meadow_tree_2.name: alien tree
t_alien_meadow_tree_2.description: An alien tree, looking vaguely like a willow with yellow leaves.  As you look more closely, you see that the branches that touch the ground have put down roots and are forming secondary trunks.

t_alien_meadow_tree_3.name: alien tree
t_alien_meadow_tree_3.description: An alien tree, with the trunk lifted off the ground on a cluster of roots.  Giant dark-red globes the size of watermelons hang from its branches amidst clusters of dark-red leaves.

t_alien_meadow_tree_3_harvested.name: alien tree
t_alien_meadow_tree_3_harvested.description: An alien tree, with the trunk lifted off the ground on a tangle of roots.  The branches have clusters of long, dark-red leaves.

t_alien_meadow_tree_trap.name: alien tree
t_alien_meadow_tree_trap.description: An alien tree, a group of thick dark-colored trunks half-fused together.  The drooping branches have nodes of dark red leaves interspersed along their lengths.  You're not entirely sure it's moving with the wind.

t_alien_meadow_tree_trap_roots_obvious.name: alien roots
t_alien_meadow_tree_trap_roots_obvious.description: A cluster of dark roots from an alien tree are visible here.  Did one of them just move?

t_alien_meadow_pond_goo.name: strange pool
t_alien_meadow_pond_goo.description: A pool of some very thick, nearly-opaque liquid.  The surface is almost perfectly smooth.

t_nm_floor_bone.name: bone floor
t_nm_floor_bone.description: An impossibly hard, impregnable bone structure covers the internals of the beast.

t_nm_wall_bone.name: bone wall
t_nm_wall_bone.description: An amazingly durable, impregnable wall of bone stands before you, forming the outer shell of the eldritch monster.

t_nm_wall_teeth.name: monster teeth
t_nm_wall_teeth.description: A fractal array of uncountable, bristling teeth that seem impossibly sharp, even at a conceptual level.  An iridescent haze surrounds it, as if light itself cannot help but be separated in their presence.  You surmise you could extract some for your own use, if you had an appropriate tool to remove them from the wall they're imbedded in.

t_nm_floor_flesh.name: flesh floor
t_nm_floor_flesh.description: Walking over the innards of this monstrous beast, you can still feel movement underneath your feet.

t_nm_wall_flesh.name: flesh wall
t_nm_wall_flesh.description: Warm to the touch, the tainted flesh of this monstrous being still twitches.

t_nm_wall_cartilage.name: flesh wall
t_nm_wall_cartilage.description: A thick wall of fleshy cartilage.  With the proper tools, you could smash right through it.

t_nm_wall_flesh_pupating.name: flesh wall
t_nm_wall_flesh_pupating.description: This section of flesh seems hollowed out.  You can see silky, translucent larvae wriggling inside, consuming flesh at a prodigious pace.

t_nm_ichor_sh.name: monster hemolymph
t_nm_ichor_sh.description: A shallow stream of glowing yellow ichor streaks through the beast.  Peering into it, you can see dark shadows moving under the surface.

t_nm_brain.name: nether brain
t_nm_brain.description: An oozing pile of wrinkled, decomposing flesh.

t_quietfarm_border_ground.name: dirt
t_quietfarm_border_ground.description: It's dirt.  Looks like some fine soil for tillage.  Could also be dug out for construction projects.

t_quietfarm_border_fence.name: chain link fence
t_quietfarm_border_fence.description: A tall fence made of woven wires.  There aren't any gaps big enough for you to fit through, so you'll have to cut it, climb it, or find a way around.

t_quietfarm_border_fence_closed.name: closed wire gate
t_quietfarm_border_fence_closed.description: A gate for a chain link fence with a latch system to stay closed.

t_quietfarm_border_fence_open.name: open wire gate
t_quietfarm_border_fence_open.description: A gate for a chain link fence with a latch system to stay closed.  The latch is undone, so the gate has swung open.

t_vitrified_dirt.name: black glass ground
t_vitrified_dirt.description: A patch of black glass, roughly textured and entirely solid.  The little of it you can see through reveals larger, darker pebbles underneath.

t_vitrified_grass.name: black grass
t_vitrified_grass.description: A patch of thick, luxuriant midnight black grass.  Every blade is a razor.

t_vitrified_floor.name: black glass floor
t_vitrified_floor.description: A floor of black glass, textured with the knots and whorls of old and well-loved wood boards.

t_vitrified_tile.name: black glass floor
t_vitrified_tile.description: A black glass floor formed from tessellated octagonal tiles.

t_vitrified_wall.name: black glass wall
t_vitrified_wall.description: A heavy wall of black glass, textured with the knots and whorls of old and well-loved wood boards.

t_vitrified_edge.name: edge of a vastness
t_vitrified_edge.description: Beyond this point stretches an endless expanse of smooth black.  You are so small, in comparison.  And why would you even want to leave?

t_vitrified_door.name: black glass door
t_vitrified_door.description: A door made from black glass, fused shut on useless hinges.  If you look very closely, you can see the tiny ridges of fingerprints on the knob.

t_vitrified_chickenwire_fence.name: black fiberglass fence
t_vitrified_chickenwire_fence.description: A network of delicate glass threads strung between thicker posts.  The wind blowing across them produces a faint, eerie whine.

t_vitrified_fence_barbed.name: spined glasswire fence
t_vitrified_fence_barbed.description: Rolling coils of thin black glass covered in delicate barbs.  It's reminiscent of snowflakes.

t_vitrified_wall_glass.name: translucent black glass wall
t_vitrified_wall_glass.description: An area of black glass translucent enough to allow murky shapes to be seen through it.

t_vitrified_sand.name: black glass dust
t_vitrified_sand.description: A pile of glass ground so finely that the slightest breeze bears it aloft into mesmerizing clouds.

t_vitrified_curtains.name: black glass curtains
t_vitrified_curtains.description: The shape of a window and trim, covered in drapings of black glass.  Presumably it was once transparent; now the opaque curtains are solid and immobile.

t_vitrified_window_frame.name: jagged glass aperture
t_vitrified_window_frame.description: A ragged hole smashed through a thin portion of black glass.  The biggest shards could probably be snapped off to make it safer to pass through.

t_vitrified_fence_post.name: black glass pole
t_vitrified_fence_post.description: A spar of glass fused into the ground, still bearing the jagged edges of the structure it once supported.

t_vitrified_water_pump.name: black glass well
t_vitrified_water_pump.description: This was formerly a well shaft and pump mechanism; it is now so obscured with bubbles of black glass that only a faint outline of the original shape can be seen.

t_vitrified_bars.name: black glass bars
t_vitrified_bars.description: Thick spars of black glass extending from floor to ceiling.

t_vitrified_column.name: black glass column
t_vitrified_column.description: A tremendous spar of black glass.

t_vitrified_pool.name: shallow black pool
t_vitrified_pool.description: At first glance, this looks like a smooth pool of black water.  Closer examination reveals it to be fine glass dust.

t_tree_apple_vitrified.name: tree of glass apples
t_tree_apple_vitrified.description: A flourishing tree, its branches heavy with apples.  Every black leaf is razor-edged; every heavy fruit turns to dust at the touch.

t_vitrified_tree.name: black glass tree

t_vitrified_bush.name: black glass bush
t_vitrified_bush.description: What was once a small shrub has grown wild, each of its branches twisting into delicate glass spirals.

t_vitrified_stairs_down.name: black glass stairs

t_vitrified_stairs_up.name: black glass stairs
t_vitrified_stairs_up.description: A set of smooth glass stairs, with countless years of bare footprints worn into them.

t_vitrified_downspout.name: black glass downspout
t_vitrified_downspout.description: A drainpipe of black glass.  There are holes down its length, from which occasionally trickle little dustings of black sand.

t_vitrified_roof.name: black glass roof

t_vitrified_gutter_drop.name: black glass drain

t_tree_walnut_harvested.description: A massive tree belonging to the 'Juglans' genus.

t_tree_butternut.name: butternut tree
t_tree_butternut.description: A massive tree belonging to the 'Juglans' genus, but with lighter bark and more elongated fruits than the more common black walnut.  If you look closely, you can see some unharvested butternuts.

t_tree_butternut_harvested.name: butternut tree
t_tree_butternut_harvested.description: A massive tree belonging to the 'Juglans' genus, but with lighter bark and more elongated fruits than the more common black walnut.

t_tree_blackjack.name: blackjack oak
t_tree_blackjack.description: A deciduous tree of the genus 'Quercus', with bark cracked into rectangular black plates split by narrow orange fissures.  You could peel off the bark sections if you examined the tree more closely.

t_tree_blackjack_harvested.name: blackjack oak
t_tree_blackjack_harvested.description: A deciduous tree of the genus 'Quercus', with bark cracked into rectangular black plates split by narrow orange fissures.  All the usable bark has been stripped off.

t_tree_alder.name: alder tree
t_tree_alder.description: A deciduous flowering tree with serrated, scalloped, round-obovate leaves, commonly forming dense groves alongside water.

t_tree_alder_harvested.name: alder tree
t_tree_alder_harvested.description: A deciduous flowering tree with serrated, scalloped, round-obovate leaves, commonly forming dense groves alongside water.

t_tree_hazelnut_harvested.description: A stubby tree belonging to the 'Corylus' genus.

t_tree_basswood.name: basswood tree
t_tree_basswood.description: The American linden.  It has pretty and sweet-smelling flowers in the summer, and you might be able to eat its young leaves in the spring.

t_tree_basswood_harvested.name: basswood tree
t_tree_basswood_harvested.description: The American linden.  It has pretty and sweet-smelling flowers in the summer, and its edible young leaves have already been harvested.

t_tree_cottonwood.name: cottonwood tree
t_tree_cottonwood.description: A large tree belonging to the 'Populus' genus, commonly found throughout the New England region.  You see some cottonwood tree bolls that can be harvested.

t_tree_cottonwood_harvested.name: cottonwood tree
t_tree_cottonwood_harvested.description: A large tree belonging to the 'Populus' genus, commonly found throughout the New England region.  All the cottonwood tree bolls have been harvested.

t_tree_elm.name: elm tree
t_tree_elm.description: A large tree belonging to the 'Ulmus' genus, commonly found throughout the New England region.

t_tree_dead.name: dead tree
t_tree_dead.description: An indiscernible tree that has withered away due to weather, fire, or otherworldly causes.

t_tree_very_dead.name: dead tree
t_tree_very_dead.description: An indiscernible tree that has withered away due to weather, fire, or otherworldly causes.  Someone or something has broken most of its dead branches, leaving little but its gnarled trunk.

t_tree_dead_warped.name: warped dead tree
t_tree_dead_warped.description: This deciduous tree's branches are warped into a spiral.  This appears to have killed it.

t_highland_holy_tree.name: dead holy tree
t_highland_holy_tree.description: Censers and candlelamps hang from the twisted branches of this tree, which seems to have been revered in the past.  A sword is embedded in its trunk.

t_highland_flower_bed.name: flower bed
t_highland_flower_bed.description: Dozens of large blue flowers grow nearly parallel to the ground .  They retain a neat arrangement even when growing wild.

t_tree_young.name: young tree
t_tree_young.description: A relatively young sapling of an indeterminate species.  It could take decades before reaching maturity, so there's no use waiting around.

t_mega_fern.name: mega fern
t_mega_fern.description: A gigantic fern like nothing you've seen before.  The leaves are a bright scarlet with a net-like structure of green veins.  The multipronged trunks have the texture of balsa wood.

t_tree_apple.name: apple tree
t_tree_apple.description: This tree is a member of the 'Malus' genus, producing fruit commonly known as apples.  If you examined the branches more closely, you could probably find a few mature ones in autumn.

t_tree_apple_harvested.name: apple tree
t_tree_apple_harvested.description: This tree is a member of the 'Malus' genus, producing fruit commonly known as apples.  There do not appear to be any ripe apples now.

t_tree_crabapple.name: crabapple tree
t_tree_crabapple.description: This tree is a member of the 'Malus' genus, though unlike popular cultivars, its fruits are small and sour.  If you examined the branches more closely, you could probably find a few mature ones in autumn.

t_tree_crabapple_harvested.name: crabapple tree
t_tree_crabapple_harvested.description: This tree is a member of the 'Malus' genus, though unlike popular cultivars, its fruits are small and sour.  There do not appear to be any ripe crabapples now.

t_tree_pear.name: pear tree
t_tree_pear.description: This is 'Pyrus communis', or the common pear tree, which produces fruit in the fall.  If you examined the branches more closely, you could probably find a few mature ones.

t_tree_pear_harvested.name: pear tree
t_tree_pear_harvested.description: This is 'Pyrus communis', or the common pear tree, which produces fruit in the fall.  Looks like all the ripe pears have been picked.

t_tree_coffee.name: coffee tree
t_tree_coffee.description: This is 'Gymnocladus dioicus', or the Kentucky coffee tree, which produces roastable coffee pods and brewable leaves in the fall.  If you examined the branches more closely, you could probably find a few mature ones.

t_tree_coffee_harvested.name: coffee tree
t_tree_coffee_harvested.description: This is 'Gymnocladus dioicus', or the Kentucky coffee tree, which produces roastable coffee pods and brewable leaves in the fall.  Looks like all the ripe pods have been picked.

t_tree_cherry.name: cherry tree
t_tree_cherry.description: One of the several species of 'Prunus' trees found in New England, it bears cherries in the summer.  If you examined the foliage more closely, you could probably find some viable clusters.

t_tree_cherry_harvested.name: cherry tree
t_tree_cherry_harvested.description: One of the several species of 'Prunus' trees found in New England, it bears cherries in the summer.  Looks like all the ripe bunches of cherries have been picked.

t_tree_juniper.name: juniper tree
t_tree_juniper.description: One of the species of 'Juniperus' that grows in New England, juniper berries grow over two to three years.  It flowers in the first year, produces a green berry the second, and in the third produces the more famed blue varieties.  If you examined the foliage more closely, you could probably find some viable clusters.

t_tree_juniper_harvested.name: juniper tree
t_tree_juniper_harvested.description: One of the species of 'Juniperus' that grows in New England, juniper berries grow over two to three years.  It flowers in the first year, produces a green berry the second, and in the third produces the more famed blue varieties.  Looks like all the ripe bunches of berries have been picked.

t_tree_peach.name: peach tree
t_tree_peach.description: One of the several species of 'Prunus' trees found in New England, it bears peaches in the summer.  If you examined the branches more closely, you could probably find some mature peaches.

t_tree_peach_harvested.name: peach tree
t_tree_peach_harvested.description: One of the several species of 'Prunus' trees found in New England, it bears peaches in the summer.  Looks like all the ripe peaches have been picked.

t_tree_apricot.name: apricot tree
t_tree_apricot.description: A transplanted species of 'Prunus armeniaca', rarely found in New England.  It produces apricots in the summer.  If you examined the spurs more closely, you could probably find some mature apricots.

t_tree_apricot_harvested.name: apricot tree
t_tree_apricot_harvested.description: A transplanted species of 'Prunus armeniaca', rarely found in New England.  It produces apricots in the summer.  Looks like all the ripe apricots have been picked.

t_tree_plum.name: plum tree
t_tree_plum.description: One of the several species of 'Prunus' trees found in New England, it produces plums in the summer.  If you examined the spurs more closely, you could probably find some ripe plums.

t_tree_plum_harvested.name: plum tree
t_tree_plum_harvested.description: One of the several species of 'Prunus' trees found in New England, it produces plums in the summer.  Looks like all the ripe plums have been picked.

t_tree_mulberry.name: mulberry tree
t_tree_mulberry.description: This tree is a member of the 'Morus' genus, producing fruit commonly known as mulberries.  In the summer, many berries can be picked.

t_tree_mulberry_harvested.name: mulberry tree
t_tree_mulberry_harvested.description: This tree is a member of the 'Morus' genus, producing fruit commonly known as mulberries.  There do not appear to be any ripe mulberries now.

t_tree_tupelo.name: tupelo tree
t_tree_tupelo.description: Its name, originating from Native American tongues and garbled by the settlers, approximately means "swamp tree".  During autumn it bears cherry-like fruits.

t_tree_tupelo_harvested.name: tupelo tree
t_tree_tupelo_harvested.description: Its name, originating from Native American tongues and garbled by the settlers, approximately means "swamp tree".  During autumn it bears cherry-like fruits, but someone picked this one clean already.

t_tree_nannyberry.name: nannyberry tree
t_tree_nannyberry.description: This small tree, it could almost be a large shrub, bears clusters of dark blue berries in autumn.

t_tree_nannyberry_harvested.name: nannyberry tree
t_tree_nannyberry_harvested.description: This small tree, it could almost be a large shrub, bears clusters of dark blue berries in autumn, but someone picked this one clean already.

t_tree_elderberry.name: elderberry tree
t_tree_elderberry.description: This tree is a member of the 'Sambucus' genus, producing fruit commonly known as elderberries.  In the summer, many berries can be picked.

t_tree_elderberry_harvested.name: elderberry tree
t_tree_elderberry_harvested.description: This tree is a member of the 'Sambucus' genus, producing fruit commonly known as elderberries.  There do not appear to be any ripe elderberries now.

t_tree_pine.name: pine tree
t_tree_pine.description: A towering coniferous tree that belongs to the 'Pinus' genus, with the New England species varying from 'P. strobus', 'P. resinosa' and 'P. rigida'.  If you examined the tree more closely, you might find usable sticky whorls, resin clumps, and pinecones.

t_tree_pine_harvested.name: pine tree
t_tree_pine_harvested.description: A towering coniferous tree that belongs to the 'Pinus' genus, with the New England species varying from 'P. strobus', 'P. resinosa' and 'P. rigida'.  Some of the branches and resin clumps have been stripped away and many of the pinecones aren't developed fully yet, but given a season, it could be harvestable again.

t_tree_spruce.name: spruce tree
t_tree_spruce.description: A towering coniferous tree that belongs to the 'Picea' genus, generally growing in northern temperate and boreal climates.

t_tree_deadpine.name: dead pine tree
t_tree_deadpine.description: A towering coniferous tree that belongs to the 'Pinus' genus, with the New England species varying from 'P. strobus', 'P. resinosa' and 'P. rigida'.  This tree's branches are bare, and it appears to be dead.

t_tree_deadpine_warped.name: warped dead pine tree
t_tree_deadpine_warped.description: The branches of this pine tree have been twisted into a shape that remind you of Sierpinski triangles.  It did not survive being warped like this.

t_tree_birch.name: birch tree
t_tree_birch.description: A tall deciduous tree of the 'Betula' genus, with the characteristic peeling bark.  Species like 'B. alleghaniensis', 'B. papyrifera', and 'B. populifolia' are the most common in the New England region.  You could tear off some strips of bark if you examined the tree more closely.

t_tree_birch_harvested.name: birch tree
t_tree_birch_harvested.description: A tall deciduous tree of the 'Betula' genus, with the characteristic peeling bark.  Species like 'B. alleghaniensis', 'B. papyrifera', and 'B. populifolia' are the most common in the New England region.  Looks like there isn't enough rhytidome to peel off yet.

t_tree_willow.name: willow tree
t_tree_willow.description: A tall, wide deciduous tree of the 'Salix' genus, with long, thin, leafy branches that hang down like curtains.  You could tear off some bark.

t_tree_willow_harvested.name: willow tree
t_tree_willow_harvested.description: A tall, wide deciduous tree of the 'Salix' genus, with long, thin, leafy branches that hang down like curtains.  Looks like all usable bark has been torn off, and new rhytidomes have not formed yet.

t_tree_maple.name: maple tree
t_tree_maple.description: A large deciduous tree of the 'Acer' genus.  The leaves are distinctively shaped with five prongs.  It could be tapped in order to extract maple sap.

t_tree_maple_tapped.name: maple tree
t_tree_maple_tapped.description: A large deciduous tree of the 'Acer' genus.  The leaves are distinctively shaped with five prongs.  A spigot is wedged into the trunk, and sweet maple sap can be extracted.

t_tree_hickory.name: hickory tree
t_tree_hickory.description: A tall deciduous tree of the 'Carya' genus.  You could look for hickory nuts if you examined the tree more closely.

t_tree_hickory_harvested.description: A tall deciduous tree of the 'Carya' genus.  It looks like the tree has been picked clean of hickory nuts.
t_tree_hickory_harvested.name: hickory tree

t_tree_pistachio.name: pistachio tree
t_tree_pistachio.description: A deciduous tree of the 'Pistacia' genus.  This is a cultivated tree, and is not native to this region.  You could look for pistachio nuts if you examined the tree more closely.

t_tree_pistachio_harvested.name: pistachio tree
t_tree_pistachio_harvested.description: A deciduous tree of the 'Pistacia' genus.  This is a cultivated tree, and is not native to this region.  Unfortunately, it looks like it has been picked clean of pistachio nuts.

t_tree_almond.name: almond tree
t_tree_almond.description: A deciduous tree of the 'Prunus' genus.  This is a cultivated tree, and is not native to this region.  You could look for fresh almonds if you examined the tree more closely.

t_tree_almond_harvested.description: A deciduous tree of the 'Prunus' genus.  This is a cultivated tree, and is not native to this region.  There are no almonds left to pick on the tree.
t_tree_almond_harvested.name: almond tree

t_tree_pecan.name: pecan tree
t_tree_pecan.description: A tall deciduous tree of the 'Carya' genus.  You could look for pecan nuts if you examined the tree more closely.

t_tree_pecan_harvested.name: pecan tree
t_tree_pecan_harvested.description: A tall deciduous tree of the 'Carya' genus.  It doesn't look like there are any pecan nuts left on the tree.

t_tree_hickory_dead.name: dead hickory tree
t_tree_hickory_dead.description: The dead remnants of a tall deciduous tree of the 'Carya' genus.  Nothing useful can be foraged from this poor, dead tree.

t_tree_sassafras.name: sassafras tree
t_tree_sassafras.description: This tree is a member of the 'Sassafras' genus, known for its aromatic qualities.  In the winter and spring, the sap rich roots can be harvested to make a sweet beverage.

t_tree_sassafras_harvested.name: sassafras tree
t_tree_sassafras_harvested.description: This tree is a member of the 'Sassafras' genus, known for its aromatic qualities.  This tree's roots have been harvested, any more and the tree will die.

t_underbrush.name: underbrush
t_underbrush.description: Small plants and shrubs that decorate the forest.  An observant forager could obtain edible plants, acorns, eggs, and mushrooms from it.

t_underbrush_harvested.name: underbrush
t_underbrush_harvested.description: Small plants and shrubs that decorate the forest.  It has been rummaged through and doesn't have anything useful left to forage from it.

t_beehive_natural.name: bee hive
t_beehive_natural.description: A hive of bees located in a cavity inside a tree, swarming in and out at a feverish pace.  There's probably honey inside.

t_apiary.name: apiary
t_apiary.description: A man-made wooden box designed to hold honeybees and facilitate the care for a hive.  The modular construction allows for inspecting the bees and harvesting their bounty without destroying the hive completely.  This year's harvest should be ready by now.

t_apiary_empty.name: apiary
t_apiary_empty.description: A man-made wooden box designed to host honeybees and facilitate the care for a hive.  The modular construction allows for inspecting the bees and harvesting their bounty without destroying the hive completely.  It will be some time before this one is ready to harvest.

t_shrub_peanut.name: peanut bush
t_shrub_peanut.description: A small bush of crunchy peanuts.

t_shrub_peanut_harvested.name: peanut bush
t_shrub_peanut_harvested.description: A small peanut bush that's fruitless.

t_shrub_autumn_olive.name: autumn olive
t_shrub_autumn_olive.description: An invasive species from Japan which is also called silverberry.  Widely planted in the 1940s to combat erosion, it spread far and wide, often even displacing native plants.  As it name says, it bears fruits in autumn, which are quite unlike olives.

t_shrub_autumn_olive_harvested.name: autumn olive
t_shrub_autumn_olive_harvested.description: An invasive species from Japan which is also called silverberry.  Widely planted in the 1940s to combat erosion, it spread far and wide, often even displacing native plants.  As it name says, it bears fruits in autumn, which are quite unlike olives, but this particular plant has been harvested already.

t_shrub_hobblebush.name: hobblebush
t_shrub_hobblebush.description: Called hobblebush because it may hinder and trip, hobbles, unwary hikers with its branches bending over and taking root.  It also bears surprisingly sweet berries in autumn.

t_shrub_hobblebush_harvested.name: hobblebush
t_shrub_hobblebush_harvested.description: Called hobblebush because it may hinder and trip, hobbles, unwary hikers with its branches bending over and taking root.  It also bears surprisingly sweet berries in autumn, if it hadn't been picked clean already.

t_shrub_blueberry.name: blueberry bush
t_shrub_blueberry.description: A small bush of sweet blueberries.

t_shrub_blueberry_harvested.name: blueberry bush
t_shrub_blueberry_harvested.description: A small blueberry bush that's fruitless.

t_shrub_strawberry.name: strawberry bush
t_shrub_strawberry.description: A small bush of juicy strawberries.

t_shrub_strawberry_harvested.name: strawberry bush
t_shrub_strawberry_harvested.description: A small strawberry bush that's fruitless.

t_shrub_blackberry.name: blackberry bush
t_shrub_blackberry.description: A small bush of delicious blackberries.  Watch out for its thorns!

t_shrub_blackberry_harvested.name: blackberry bush
t_shrub_blackberry_harvested.description: A small blackberry bush that's fruitless.  Watch out for its thorns!

t_shrub_huckleberry.name: huckleberry bush
t_shrub_huckleberry.description: A small bush of huckleberries, often mistaken for blueberries.

t_shrub_huckleberry_harvested.name: huckleberry bush
t_shrub_huckleberry_harvested.description: A small huckleberry bush that's fruitless.

t_shrub_raspberry.name: raspberry bush
t_shrub_raspberry.description: A small bush of delicious raspberries.  Watch out for its thorns!

t_shrub_raspberry_harvested.name: raspberry bush
t_shrub_raspberry_harvested.description: A small raspberry bush that's fruitless.  Watch out for its thorns!

t_shrub_grape.name: grape bush
t_shrub_grape.description: A bush of a different species invaded by grape vines.

t_shrub_grape_harvested.name: grape bush
t_shrub_grape_harvested.description: A bush of a different species invaded by grape vines, but they're fruitless.

t_shrub_spicebush.name: spicebush
t_shrub_spicebush.description: A bush that features small, red berries.

t_shrub_spicebush_harvested.name: spicebush
t_shrub_spicebush_harvested.description: A bush that usually features small, red berries but it was picked clean.

t_shrub_chokeberry.name: black chokeberry bush
t_shrub_chokeberry.description: Drooping black berries adorn the shrub during autumn.  These have a distinctive star-shaped fold and look quite juicy.

t_shrub_chokeberry_harvested.name: black chokeberry bush
t_shrub_chokeberry_harvested.description: Drooping black berries adorned this shrub, but the shrub was picked clean.

t_shrub_rose.name: rose bush
t_shrub_rose.description: A fat bush of beautiful red roses, if only you could get a date!  Watch out for its thorns!

t_shrub_rose_harvested.name: rose bush
t_shrub_rose_harvested.description: A fat rose bush that currently has no blooms.  Watch out for its thorns!

t_shrub_hydrangea.name: hydrangea bush
t_shrub_hydrangea.description: A dense bush of fragrant blue hydrangeas.

t_shrub_hydrangea_harvested.name: hydrangea bush
t_shrub_hydrangea_harvested.description: A fat hydrangea bush that currently has no blooms.

t_shrub_lilac.name: lilac bush
t_shrub_lilac.description: A wide bush of bright pinkish-purple lilacs.

t_shrub_lilac_harvested.name: lilac bush
t_shrub_lilac_harvested.description: A wide lilac bush that currently has no blooms.

t_trunk.name: tree trunk
t_trunk.description: A section of trunk from a tree that has been cut down.  Can be sawn into logs with the right tool.

t_stump.name: tree stump
t_stump.description: A tree stump, a remnant of a tree that has been cut down.

t_woodchips.name: woodchips
t_woodchips.description: Small splinters of wood laid out in a layer to prevent unwanted plants from growing.

t_moss.name: moss
t_moss.description: A patch of moist, spongy moss.

t_grass.name: grass
t_grass.description: An area of hardy Kentucky bluegrass about ankle high.  Cutting the grass short enough would destroy the root system, causing this area to turn into a patch of dirt.

t_grass_white.name: white grass
t_grass_white.description: An area of Kentucky bluegrass covered in white latex-based paint, with neat lines designed for recreational sports.

t_grass_long.name: long grass
t_grass_long.description: An area of long, shaggy grass about shin high.

t_grass_tall.name: tall grass
t_grass_tall.description: An area of tall grass about head high.

t_grass_dead.name: dead grass
t_grass_dead.description: An area of long, shaggy grass that hasn't been cut recently.

t_grass_grazed.name: grazed grass
t_grass_grazed.description: An area of extremely short green stubble protruding from the dirt.  Something has been clearly grazing here.

t_grass_golf.name: golf green
t_grass_golf.description: An area of grass mowed very short and neat.

t_grass_alien.name: alien grass
t_grass_alien.description: An area of something that almost looks like grass.  The blades are serrated and move on their own.

t_golf_hole.name: golf hole
t_golf_hole.description: A small plastic cup embedded in an area of very short, neat grass.

t_bamboo.name: young bamboo shoots
t_bamboo.description: An area of young bamboo shoots about ankle high.  Many shoots are just barely pushing above the ground.

t_bamboo_harvested.name: young bamboo shoots
t_bamboo_harvested.description: An area of young bamboo shoots about ankle high.  The smallest shoots have already been harvested.

t_bamboo_long.name: long bamboo shoots
t_bamboo_long.description: An area of long bamboo shoots about shin high.

t_bamboo_tall.name: tall bamboo
t_bamboo_tall.description: A tall bamboo thicket about head high.

t_bamboo_dead.name: dead bamboo
t_bamboo_dead.description: An area of long, brown, dead bamboo shoots covered in white fungus.

t_fern.name: fern
t_fern.description: A short plant with thousands of leaves which grow in a fractal pattern from the stem.

t_fern_harvested.name: fern
t_fern_harvested.description: A short plant with thousands of leaves which grow in a fractal pattern.  All of the curled shoots have been harvested.

t_fungus_colony.name: mushroom colony
t_fungus_colony.description: A large pile of organic matter which has molded over with fungus.  The caps of many mundane mushrooms spring from the top, you can even recognize some.  The fungi growing here don't seem edible, though.

t_marloss.name: Marloss bush
t_marloss.description: This alien plant superficially resembles a blueberry bush, and hangs with large, juicy pink pomes that emit a heady, fruity aroma.

t_fungus.name: fungal bed
t_fungus.description: Fungus grows thick here, obscuring the ground beneath it.

t_fungus_floor_in.name: fungal floor
t_fungus_floor_in.description: Grayish mold coats both the floor and the roof here, silent and still.  Stray spores waft through the air.

t_fungus_floor_sup.name: fungal floor
t_fungus_floor_sup.description: Grayish mold coats the floor here, silent and still.

t_fungus_floor_out.name: fungal floor
t_fungus_floor_out.description: Grayish mold coats the ground here, silent and still.

t_fungus_wall.name: fungal wall
t_fungus_wall.description: Several thick, large tendrils of fungus perforate the wall here, piercing straight through it from the outside.  Despite the apparent damage, the wall is still structurally sound.

t_fungus_wall_transformed.name: fungal wall
t_fungus_wall_transformed.description: The fungus here has grown thickly and tightly enough to form a solid wall.  It feels very stiff to the touch, and seems to be very strong.

t_fungus_mound.name: fungal mound
t_fungus_mound.description: A mound of fungal matter, intertwined in itself.

t_shrub_fungal.name: fungal shrub
t_shrub_fungal.description: This shrub has been completely absorbed by the mushrooms.  Its branches droop and have lost much of their structure, and its leaves have vanished, replaced by fleshy gray sacks that visibly expand and contract.

t_tree_fungal.name: fungal tree
t_tree_fungal.description: Once tall and majestic, this tree is now a slave to the fungus like the landscape around it.  Its bark is penetrated by and covered with fungal tendrils, and the canopy has rotted away, leaving only the branches, stretching forlornly to the sky as if to escape the infection overrunning it.

t_tree_fungal_young.name: young fungal tree
t_tree_fungal_young.description: A small sapling poking through the ground, infested by fungal mold.

t_marloss_tree.name: Marloss tree
t_marloss_tree.description: This tree stands as a stark outlier to the landscape around it.  Despite its infestation, its leaves wave proudly in the wind, colored pinkish-white.  Its branches are heavy with pink fruit that looks both mutated and delicious.

t_pavement_hw_air.name: bridge pavement
t_pavement_hw_air.description: A bridge section made out of concrete and metal.

t_pavement_y_hw_air.name: bridge yellow pavement
t_pavement_y_hw_air.description: A bridge section made out of concrete and metal.  It's painted yellow.

t_sidewalk_hw_air.name: bridge sidewalk
t_sidewalk_hw_air.description: The sidewalk section of a concrete bridge.

t_ice_sh_thin.name: thin ice
t_ice_sh_thin.description: A thin layer of ice covering shallow water.  It may not support much weight.

t_ice_sh_thick.name: thick ice
t_ice_sh_thick.description: A solid sheet of thick ice covering shallow water.  It should support weight.

t_ice_dp_thin.name: thin ice
t_ice_dp_thin.description: A thin layer of ice covering deep water.  It may break under weight.

t_ice_dp_thick.name: thick ice
t_ice_dp_thick.description: A thick sheet of ice covering deep water.  It should support weight, but danger remains below.

t_pseudo_phase.name: pseudo phase
t_pseudo_phase.description: Placeholder terrain representing the original tile for PHASE_BACK behavior.  Should not be seen in-game.

t_water_sh.name: shallow water
t_water_sh.description: The water isn't too deep here.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_water_sh_underground.name: shallow water
t_water_sh_underground.description: The water isn't too deep here.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_water_dp.name: deep water
t_water_dp.description: You're having trouble seeing the bottom through the deep water here.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_water_dp_underground.name: deep water
t_water_dp_underground.description: You're having trouble seeing the bottom through the deep water here.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_water_murky.name: murky shallow water
t_water_murky.description: The water isn't too deep here but is murky with organic matter.  With a watertight container, you could gather fetid water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_water_sh_murky_underground.name: murky shallow water
t_water_sh_murky_underground.description: The water isn't too deep here but it is murky with organic matter.  With a watertight container, you could gather fetid water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_water_moving_sh.name: flowing shallow water
t_water_moving_sh.description: The streaming water isn't too deep here.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is, although probably safer than stagnant water.

t_water_moving_sh_underground.name: flowing shallow water
t_water_moving_sh_underground.description: The streaming water isn't too deep here.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is, although probably safer than stagnant water.

t_water_moving_dp.name: flowing deep water
t_water_moving_dp.description: The streaming water looks deep here.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is, although probably safer than stagnant water.

t_water_moving_dp_underground.name: flowing deep water
t_water_moving_dp_underground.description: The streaming water looks deep here.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is, although probably safer than stagnant water.

t_swater_sh.name: shallow water
t_swater_sh.description: The water isn't too deep here.  With a watertight container, you could gather salt water from here.

t_swater_sh_underground.name: shallow water
t_swater_sh_underground.description: The water isn't too deep here.  With a watertight container, you could gather salt water from here.

t_swater_dp.name: deep water
t_swater_dp.description: You're having trouble seeing the bottom through the deep water here.  With a watertight container, you could gather salt water from here.

t_swater_dp_underground.name: deep water
t_swater_dp_underground.description: You're having trouble seeing the bottom through the deep water here.  With a watertight container, you could gather salt water from here.

t_swater_surf.name: surf
t_swater_surf.description: A broad area of fine sand, washed by waves coming in from the sea.

t_water_pool.name: pool water
t_water_pool.description: A deep pool full of water.  Never swim without a lifeguard present.  Even though monsters probably ate them.

t_water_pool_outdoors.name: pool water
t_water_pool_outdoors.description: A deep pool full of water.  Never swim without a lifeguard present.  Even though monsters probably ate them.

t_sewage.name: sewage
t_sewage.description: Gross.  Sewage water flows through here.  As if it needed saying, this isn't safe to drink.

t_lava.name: lava
t_lava.description: An extremely hot, glowing liquid, composed of molten rock and/or metal.  In some places, lava-grilled steak is a delicacy.

t_water_cube.name: submersed water
t_water_cube.description: You are submerged below the surface of the water, your feet can't touch the ground.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_saltwater_cube.name: submersed salt water
t_saltwater_cube.description: You are submerged below the surface of the water, your feet can't touch the ground.  With a watertight container, you could gather salt water from here.

t_lake_bed.name: lake bed
t_lake_bed.description: You are standing at the bottom of a body of fresh water.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_ocean_bed.name: ocean bed
t_ocean_bed.description: You are standing at the bottom of a body of salt water.  With a watertight container, you could gather salt water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_bulkhead_roof.name: bulkhead
t_bulkhead_roof.description: The top of a submerged structure.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_bulkhead_floor.name: bulkhead
t_bulkhead_floor.description: The bottom of a submerged structure.

t_lake_bed_concrete.name: submerged concrete
t_lake_bed_concrete.description: You are standing at the bottom of a body of fresh water on a pad of concrete.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_lake_bed_concrete_yellow.name: submerged concrete
t_lake_bed_concrete_yellow.description: You are standing at the bottom of a body of fresh water on a pad of yellow-painted concrete.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_water_hot.name: hot spring water
t_water_hot.description: Scalding hot water, not particularly safe for swimming.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_puddle.name: recess
t_puddle.description: A shallow pit in the ground.

t_puddle_underground.name: recess
t_puddle_underground.description: A shallow pit in the ground.

t_water_sh_flood.name: flood water
t_water_sh_flood.description: The water isn't too deep here, it seems to have either pooled here or risen from a pipe leaking nearby.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_water_cube_hot.name: warm water
t_water_cube_hot.description: You are submerged below the surface of warm water, your feet can't touch the ground.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_metal_floor_submerged_hot.name: submerged metal floor
t_metal_floor_submerged_hot.description: You are standing at the bottom of a body of warm fresh water on a metal floor.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_water_dp_underground_hot.name: deep water
t_water_dp_underground_hot.description: You're having trouble seeing the bottom through the warm, deep water here.  With a watertight container, you could gather fresh water from here.  Not safe to drink as is.

t_interstice_mutagen_sh.name: perfectly clear water
t_interstice_mutagen_sh.description: A pool of what appears to be, in most respects, water.  However, it's so clear that you can barely perceive it unless in motion.

t_interstice_mutagen_pool.name: perfectly clear water
t_interstice_mutagen_pool.description: This is clearly a swimming pool, but it contains just a shallow layer of what appears to be, in most respects, water.  However, the liquid is so clear that you can barely perceive it unless in motion.

t_recycler.name: metal compactor
t_recycler.description: A hydraulic machine for squeezing scrap into more compact chunks.  Useless now that there's no power.

t_gas_pump.name: gasoline pump
t_gas_pump.description: Precious GASOLINE.  The former world bowed to their petroleum god as it led them to their ruin.  There's plenty left over to fuel your inner road warrior.  If this gas dispenser doesn't give up the goods for free, you may have to pay at a nearby terminal.

t_gas_pump_a.name: gasoline pump
t_gas_pump_a.description: Precious GASOLINE.  The former world bowed to their petroleum god as it led them to their ruin.  There's plenty left over to fuel your inner road warrior.  If this gas dispenser doesn't give up the goods for free, you may have to pay at a nearby terminal.

t_gas_pump_smashed.name: smashed gas pump
t_gas_pump_smashed.description: The horror!  This gasoline pump has been destroyed, denying you access to the liquid gold.

t_diesel_pump.name: diesel pump
t_diesel_pump.description: A diesel fuel pump.  This roadside attraction provides all the thick, gloopy liquid POWER you need to move your sensibly oversized APOCALYPTIC SUPERTRUCK from point A to points beyond.  If it doesn't dispense fuel immediately, try banging on it or grunt your way over the nearby payment terminal.

t_diesel_pump_a.name: diesel pump
t_diesel_pump_a.description: A diesel fuel pump.  This roadside attraction provides all the thick, gloopy liquid POWER you need to move your sensibly oversized APOCALYPTIC SUPERTRUCK from point A to points beyond.  If it doesn't dispense fuel immediately, try banging on it or grunt your way over the nearby payment terminal.

t_diesel_pump_smashed.name: smashed diesel pump
t_diesel_pump_smashed.description: You're not getting any diesel out of this pump any time soon.  Some barbarian decided to take their frustration out on it.

t_jp8_pump.name: JP8 pump
t_jp8_pump.description: A pump that dispenses JP8.  If this gas dispenser doesn't give up the goods for free, you may have to pay at a nearby terminal.

t_underwater_drill_string.name: drill string
t_underwater_drill_string.description: An extremely resistant length of mechanical tubing used to reach deep under water and drill into pockets of oil.

t_nanofab_body.name: nanofabricator
t_nanofab_body.description: A great column of advanced machinery.  Within this self-contained, miniaturized factory, several 3D printers work in tandem with a robotic assembler to manufacture nearly any inorganic object.

t_vat.name: cloning vat

t_slot_machine.name: slot machine
t_slot_machine.description: A machine with a bright screen flashing hypnotic promises of wealth.  If gambling with your life on a daily basis isn't enough for you, you can also gamble with this.

t_salt_water_pump.name: salt water pump
t_salt_water_pump.description: A water pump connected to a pipe supplying it with salt water.  Not good to drink, but it has other uses.

t_water_dispenser.description: A machine with several taps that dispenses clean water.

t_potential_trans.name: potential transformer

t_conveyor.description: A conveyor belt.  Used to transport things.

t_milking_machine.description: A machine used in the dairy industry to milk cows.

t_rockyobstacle.name: rocky obstacle
t_rockyobstacle.description: Some larger rocks arranged and crudely rammed into the ground to slow down who or whatever is trying to cross.

t_rootcellar.name: root cellar
t_rootcellar.description: A cellar dug into the earth for storing food in a cool environment.

t_covered_well.name: covered well
t_covered_well.description: A deep well, collecting groundwater.  You won't be able to get any water unless you add some mechanism for drawing it up to the surface.

t_covered_salt_water_well.name: covered salt water well
t_covered_salt_water_well.description: A deep well, collecting salt water from a surrounding swamp.  You won't be able to get any water unless you add some mechanism for drawing it up to the surface.

t_pit_straw.name: pit filled with straw
t_pit_straw.description: A shallow pit filled with some straw.  Very crude.  Itchy and uncomfortable, but better than the bare ground.

t_improvised_shelter.name: improvised shelter
t_improvised_shelter.description: An improvised shelter providing a little bit of protection, that can be used to take refuge from the elements or to protect a campfire from the rain.

t_improvised_shelter_filled.description: An improvised shelter which has been made a bit more comfortable by filling it with dry plant matter, which should provide some more insulation.  Trying to contain a fire here would be a bad idea.

t_leanto.name: pine lean-to
t_leanto.description: A small shelter, roofed with pine branches, that can be used to take refuge from the elements or to protect a campfire from the rain.

t_tarptent.name: tarp lean-to

t_wall_resin.name: resin wall
t_wall_resin.description: A wall made of a glistening, nearly opaque, plastic-like substance.  Deep within, you can barely see a network of pulsating green conduits, snaking through it like blood vessels.  The material is hard, warm to the touch, and slightly damp.

t_wall_resin_cage.name: resin cage
t_wall_resin_cage.description: A resin wall that opens into a series of small honeycomb-like hexagons, allowing the passage of air and light.  While still made of the same sturdy material, it is thinner and more delicate in appearance.

t_floor_resin.name: resin floor
t_floor_resin.description: A nearly opaque, plastic-like floor.  It has a gentle curve from wall to wall, but in the central areas is quite flat.  The material is hard, warm to the touch, and slightly damp.

t_platform_resin.name: resin floor
t_platform_resin.description: A nearly opaque, plastic-like floor that is smooth and flat.  The material is hard, warm to the touch, and slightly damp.

t_resin_roof.name: resin roof
t_resin_roof.description: A wide, domed section of nearly opaque, plastic-like material.  When the light hits it, a network of multicolored conduits like blood vessels can be seen snaking through its glistening interior.

t_resin_hole_c.name: closed resin portal
t_resin_hole_c.description: A tricuspid hatch of some sort of damp, flexible, resinous material.  This one is closed tightly, but it looks like a firm push would cause it to snap open.

t_resin_hole_o.name: open resin portal
t_resin_hole_o.description: A tricuspid hatch of some sort of damp, flexible, resinous material.  This one is open, the flaps held out by some sort of stringy mucus-like substance.

t_resin_hole.name: resin-lined hole

t_railroad_tie_d2.name: railroad tie

t_railroad_crossing_signal.name: railroad crossing signal
t_railroad_crossing_signal.description: Traffic lights meant to light and make noise when a train approaches, to prevent people from turning into meaty mush while they cross the tracks.  Won't stop people from turning into meaty mush by other means, though.

t_railroad_track_recessed.name: recessed railroad track
