t_inner_cabins_void.name: sprawling plane of black
t_inner_cabins_void.description: There's an otherworldly surface here, black as the depths of the earth.

t_inner_cabins_void_trans.name: fluid void
t_inner_cabins_void_trans.description: At first glance this looks like a pool of dark water, slowly undulating in an unnaturally slow fashion.  The air around it is frigid cold, stale, and softens ambient light.  It does not look safe to walk through, but you could try.

t_inner_cabins_void_trans_retracting.name: fluid void
t_inner_cabins_void_trans_retracting.description: At first glance this looks like a pool of dark water, slowly undulating in an unnaturally slow fashion.  The air around it is frigid cold, stale, softens ambient light.  This patch seems to be slowly retracting toward the center of the pool.  The grass growing at its edges wobbles as if there is a breeze, constantly bending toward the blackness.  It does not look safe to walk through, but you could try.

t_inner_cabins_exit_portal.name: unstable portal
t_inner_cabins_exit_portal.description: A swirling tear in reality.  Beyond it, you see a field of ever-expanding buildings.  Something else is moving inside, beyond your ability to resolve.

effect.title: There is a ledge here.  What do you want to do?
descriptions: Just a peek.
Is there another side?

t_inner_cabins_door_o.name: strange open door
t_inner_cabins_door_o.description: A wide open door swinging outward, into the darkness, beyond your reach.  The door and the frame look fresh, as if installed recently.

t_inner_cabins_nether_glass_floor.name: black glass
t_inner_cabins_nether_glass_floor.description: An endless expanse of black glass, illuminated by dim, otherworldly light.

t_gutter.description: Channels water from the roof towards the ground, it looks flimsy.
t_gutter.name: rain gutter

t_gutter_drop.name: gutter drop
t_gutter_drop.description: A spot in the gutter where the water flows into a downspout.  It looks flimsy.  You may be able to climb down here.

t_gutter_downspout.name: downspout
t_gutter_downspout.description: A length of gutter running from the roof to the ground, you could place a container underneath it to collect rainwater.  It looks flimsy.

t_flat_roof.name: flat roof
t_flat_roof.description: A flat, gray section of rooftop.

t_tar_flat_roof.name: tar paper flat roof
t_tar_flat_roof.description: A flat, gray section of rooftop covered with tar paper.

t_shingle_flat_roof.name: shingle flat roof
t_shingle_flat_roof.description: A flat section of rooftop covered with shingles.

t_thatch_roof.name: thatched roof
t_thatch_roof.description: A section of roof made out of straw.

t_metal_flat_roof.name: metal flat roof
t_metal_flat_roof.description: A section of flat, sheet metal rooftop.

t_tile_flat_roof.name: tile flat roof
t_tile_flat_roof.description: A section of flat, tiled rooftop.

t_glass_roof.name: skylight
t_glass_roof.description: A giant sheet of glass inserted into the roof to let light pass through.

t_rock_roof.name: rock roof
t_rock_roof.description: A section of flat natural rock.

t_drystone_roof.name: drystone roof
t_drystone_roof.description: A section of sturdy rooftop made of tightly-fitted stone tiles without mortar.

t_warped_roof.name: warped roof
t_warped_roof.description: A section of flat, stone-like rooftop.  It is patterned with grooves and lines that constantly shift.

t_roof_paper.name: flat roof
t_roof_paper.description: A flat surface made of ambiguous pulpy matter, covered in sticky wasp saliva.

t_roof_paper_hard.name: flat roof
t_roof_paper_hard.description: A flat surface made of hardened, ambiguous pulpy matter, covered in sticky wasp saliva.

t_concrete_roof.name: concrete roof
t_concrete_roof.description: A flat section of concrete rooftop.

t_wood_roof.name: wooden roof
t_wood_roof.description: A flat section of wooden rooftop.

t_wood_treated_roof.name: treated wooden roof
t_wood_treated_roof.description: A flat section of flame-resistant wooden rooftop.

t_metal_roof.name: metal roof
t_metal_roof.description: A high-quality and sturdy section of metallic rooftop.

t_metal_roof_red.name: red metal roof
t_metal_roof_red.description: A sturdy section of metallic rooftop, painted red for visibility and weather resistance.

t_metal_roof_sloped.name: sloped metal roof
t_metal_roof_sloped.description: A high-quality and sturdy section of metallic rooftop that is slightly sloped toward some point.

t_log_sod_roof.name: sod roof
t_log_sod_roof.description: A section of rooftop made out of sod.

t_treetop.name: treetop
t_treetop.description: The upper branches of a tree.  There's just enough room to perch here.

t_treetop_evergreen.name: treetop
t_treetop_evergreen.description: The upper branches of a tree.  There's just enough room to perch here.

t_treetop_dead.name: dead treetop
t_treetop_dead.description: The bare upper branches of a dead tree.  There's just enough room to perch here.

t_treetop_giant_fern.name: giant fern top
t_treetop_giant_fern.description: The top of some unearthly gigantic fern.  There is enough room to perch up here, but only just.

t_scarlet_light.name: scarlet light
t_scarlet_light.description: A red lamp on rods protruding from the ground.  Hard to directly look at without eye protection.

t_water_sh_scarlet.name: scarlet water
t_water_sh_scarlet.description: The water, if you can call it that, isn't very deep here.  It's difficult to tell if the water is tinted, or if it's reflecting the dim, scarlet sky.  With a watertight container, you could gather it.

t_water_sh_scarlet_wave.name: scarlet water
t_water_sh_scarlet_wave.description: The water, if you can call it that, isn't too deep here.  It's difficult to tell if the water is tinted, or if it's reflecting the dim, scarlet sky.  With a watertight container, you could gather it.

t_sand_scarlet.name: scarlet glass
t_sand_scarlet.description: What first appears to be scarlet-tinged sand is in fact dark, volcanic glass, covered in small pits and eroded curves, giving it a flowing appearance.  Gentle flecks of red and yellow minerals dot its exterior.

t_nl_obelisk_scarlet.name: Obelisk
t_nl_obelisk_scarlet.description: A dark gray obelisk.  Despite its solid appearance, the face of it seems to slightly ripple, as if it were sand, loosely suspended in space.

names: Place your hand upon the obelisk.
effect.title:
As you approach the massive obelisk,
its surface starts to warp,
like sand in the wind.
A depression quickly forms.
In the shape of your hand.
descriptions: It looks like a perfect fit for you.

t_nl_scrap_wall_scarlet.name: scrap metal spire
t_nl_scrap_wall_scarlet.description: This great spire of twisted metal is held together by fraying wires and large bolts.  It looks like you could climb it.

t_scrap_scaffolding_scarlet.name: mass of climbable metal
t_scrap_scaffolding_scarlet.description: A mass of jagged metal, climbing into the sky.  It looks sharp, but also sturdy enough to climb.

t_shore_boulder.name: smooth rocky outcropping
t_shore_boulder.description: A medium rocky outcropping, smoothed by the waves and weather.

t_shore_boulder_oyster.name: oyster-encrusted boulder
t_shore_boulder_oyster.description: An oyster-encrusted boulder, promising the potential for a tasty meal if you can get to it and pry the oysters off.

t_string_void.name: nothing
t_string_void.description: There's an otherworldly nothing there - it somehow feels like a black wall at the front of your senses, yet you can also tell what lies beyond it.

t_nl_sd_2d_sky.name: flattened sky
t_nl_sd_2d_sky.description: This is the sky, you think.  It is impossibly flattened into two dimensions.

t_nl_sd_2d_sky_walkable.name: flattened horizon
t_nl_sd_2d_sky_walkable.description: You can stand here, upon the horizon.  It is impossibly flattened into two dimensions.

t_nl_sd_2d_ground.name: flattened ground
t_nl_sd_2d_ground.description: This is the ground, you think.  It is impossibly flattened into two dimensions, and the patterns upon it are constantly shifting, like an image passing through a veined rock, its insides twisting upon the two dimensional projection.

t_string_true_void.name: nothing
t_string_true_void.description: There's an otherworldly nothing there - a black wall at the front of your senses.

t_string_x.name: impossibly thin magenta line
t_string_x.description: You perceive a magenta line here.  It seems impossibly thin - you're not even sure it has width in any meaningful sense.  In your mind's eye the space around it shimmers, and you feel you could walk upon it.

t_string_y.name: impossibly thin cyan line
t_string_y.description: You perceive a cyan line here.  It seems impossibly thin - you're not even sure it has width in any meaningful sense.  In your mind's eye the space around it shimmers, and you feel you could walk upon it.

t_string_z.name: impossibly thin yellow line
t_string_z.description: You perceive a yellow line here that extends up and down.  It seems impossibly thin - you're not even sure it has width in any meaningful sense.  In your mind's eye the space around it shimmers, and you feel you could walk upon it.  Or perhaps climb it?

t_string_xy.name: impossibly flat blue square
t_string_xy.description: You perceive a square, here.  It seems impossibly flat - you're not even sure it has depth in any meaningful sense.  In your mind's eye the space around it shimmers, and you feel you could walk upon it.

t_string_xy_plane_1.name: impossibly flat blue square
t_string_xy_plane_1.description: You perceive a square, here.  It seems impossibly flat - you're not even sure it has depth in any meaningful sense.  In your mind's eye the space around it shimmers, and you feel you could walk upon it.

t_string_xy_plane_2.name: shimmering blue square
t_string_xy_plane_2.description: You perceive a square, here.  It is both shimmering and impossibly flat - you're not even sure it has depth in any meaningful sense.  In your mind's eye the space around it shimmers, and you feel you could walk upon it.

t_string_xy_plane_3.name: wavy square
t_string_xy_plane_3.description: You perceive a square, here.  It is both waving and impossibly flat - you're not even sure it has depth in any meaningful sense.  In your mind's eye the space around it shimmers, and you feel you could walk upon it.

t_string_xyz.name: white cube
t_string_xyz.description: A true cube of space where one could go left, right, up, down, backward, or forward - it somehow reminds you of home.

t_string_gates_mech_control.name: rotary lever
t_string_gates_mech_control.description: A heavy-duty metal lever with two settings, each marked by an alien symbol.

t_string_gates_mech_control_inert.name: rotary lever
t_string_gates_mech_control_inert.description: A heavy-duty metal lever with two settings, each marked by an alien symbol.  Toggling it back and forth does nothing.

t_string_grass_alien.name: alien grass
t_string_grass_alien.description: An area of something that almost looks like grass, but a deep orange-red.  All the fern-like blades grow in one, uniform direction.

t_string_distress_beacon.name: scrap metal thing
t_string_distress_beacon.description: Part of a structure that almost looks like a small version of Earth's lunar lander.  It has exposed electronics and deployed stabilizers made of cobbled together scrap metal.  The ground at its feet appears to have been scorched long ago.

t_string_dimension_strconc_red_light.name: strong concrete floor, red utility light
t_string_dimension_strconc_red_light.description: An extremely resilient floor made from carefully placed rebar and poured concrete.  A still-functioning red utility light is attached to the ceiling above.  The metal and plastic cage around the bulb is frosted over and cracked.

t_string_dimension_meteoric_rock.name: pitted rock
t_string_dimension_meteoric_rock.description: A wall of solid rock, deeply pitted and patterned with metallic shine.

t_string_dimension_meteoric_rock_charred.name: charred rock
t_string_dimension_meteoric_rock_charred.description: A wall of solid rock, deeply pitted, charred, and coated in a residue with an acrid smell

t_ka_moonpool.name: strange moonpool
t_ka_moonpool.description: At first glance this looks like a pool filled with deep, dark water, and a ladder leading down into it.  Upon closer inspection, you note that the "liquid" is some sort of tense membrane.  When you stare, you see something on the other side, illuminated by pale light.

t_pit_shallow.name: shallow pit
t_pit_shallow.description: A pit that could be dug even deeper or filled up.  Also useful as a starting foundation for some constructions.  You can also use it to contain a fire.

t_pit.name: pit
t_pit.description: A steep hole that could seriously injure something if it fell in, potentially fatal if it was filled with sharp and dangerous things.  Deep enough for more advanced construction projects, and possibly to reach groundwater if constructed properly.

t_pit_corpsed.name: corpse filled pit
t_pit_corpsed.description: A giant trench full of corpses, maybe even a mass graveyard.  The bodies could be dug out, but nothing in here looks remotely usable.

t_pit_covered.name: covered pit
t_pit_covered.description: A deep pit with a plank placed across it, looks sturdy enough to cross safely.  The plank could be removed to make it dangerous again.

t_pit_spiked.name: spiked pit
t_pit_spiked.description: A narrow trench full of very pointy things that would easily puncture a body.

t_pit_spiked_covered.name: covered spiked pit
t_pit_spiked_covered.description: Menacing with sharp spears along the bottom, this pit has a plank across it to allow someone or something to cross safely.  The plank could be removed to make it dangerous again.

t_pit_glass.name: glass pit
t_pit_glass.description: Looks like a ton of broken glass was dumped into this pit.  Might not fatal to fall in, but it wouldn't be pleasant to try to crawl out.

t_pit_glass_covered.name: covered glass pit
t_pit_glass_covered.description: A plank has been placed carefully to allow traversal over this ditch full of large glass shards.  The plank could be removed to make it dangerous again.

t_pit_BEM_human_sample.name: dead drop pit
t_pit_BEM_human_sample.description: A seemingly innocuous shallow pit.  Careful inspection reveals a black canister half-buried in the exposed soil.

false_effect.u_message: You don't have anything to deliver.

t_den_small.name: small den
t_den_small.description: A small den that burrowing animals such as groundhogs or hares call home.

t_den_large.name: large den
t_den_large.description: A large den that burrowing animals such as bears and foxes call home.

t_slime.name: slime
t_slime.description: A disgusting, slippery mess.  Could be used to stash things, because who'd want to touch it?

t_triffid_bark_wall.name: solid bark wall
t_triffid_bark_wall.description: A solid wall of bark, enclosing the trunk of a massive tree.  It will probably burn quite well.

t_bark_wall_chipped.name: chipped bark wall
t_bark_wall_chipped.description: A solid wall of bark enclosing the trunk of a massive tree.  Some of it has been broken away.

t_bark_wall_broken.name: broken bark wall
t_bark_wall_broken.description: A formerly solid wall of bark, now almost completely destroyed and waiting to collapse.

t_triffid_wood_wall.name: solid wood wall
t_triffid_wood_wall.description: A solid wall of naturally grown wood.  Likely very flammable.

t_barkfloor.name: bark
t_barkfloor.description: A solid piece of bark covers the floor here.

t_barkfloor_noroof.name: bark
t_barkfloor_noroof.description: A solid piece of bark covers the floor here.

t_triffid_leaves.name: branches with leaves
t_triffid_leaves.description: Thin branches emerge here, covered with thick, large leaves.

t_root_floor.name: root floor
t_root_floor.description: A dirt floor covered with roots.

t_triffid_slope_down.name: downward root slope
t_triffid_slope_down.description: A downward-facing slope of root-covered dirt.

t_triffid_slope_up.name: upward root slope
t_triffid_slope_up.description: An upward-facing slope of root-covered dirt.

t_bramble_door_c.name: closed bramble roots
t_bramble_door_c.description: A bramble of roots covering a large hole.  They could easily be pulled apart.

t_bramble_door_o.name: open bramble roots
t_bramble_door_o.description: A bramble of roots, pulled apart to reveal a hole.

t_wall.name: wall
t_wall.description: A standard wall consisting of a wooden support structure filled with insulation and drywalled.  Painted a neutral off-white or cream color, it could use some more vibrant paint.  Looks flammable.

t_wall_half.name: half-built wall
t_wall_half.description: An incomplete wall of refined wood, dotted with carefully placed nails to provide proper support.  It requires some more planks and nails before it'd be considered a suitable wall.

t_ponywall.name: pony wall
t_ponywall.description: A short divider wall consisting of a wooden support structure with drywall.  Painted an all-too-common and neutral off-white or cream color.  Looks flammable.

t_wall_wood.name: wooden wall
t_wall_wood.description: A finished wall of planks and support beams, capable of supporting an upper level or roof.  Highly flammable.

t_concrete_wall.name: concrete wall
t_concrete_wall.description: An aesthetically pleasing design with simple lines, this type of concrete was used with a weaker chemical mixture in order to have faster setting times.  Not ideal for multi-story buildings, but still capable of supporting a roof.

t_sconc_wall.name: simple concrete wall
t_sconc_wall.description: A durable and uniform concrete wall, quite drab without decoration.  More than capable of supporting a roof, as well as keeping out most anything, save for vehicles.

t_strconc_wall.name: reinforced concrete wall
t_strconc_wall.description: An extremely resilient wall, filled with concrete and rebar.  Best suited for supporting multi-level buildings, only serious explosives and high-speed impacts would be capable of damaging this wall.

t_sconc_wall_halfway.description: A partially-poured concrete wall that could probably keep anything behind it quite safe if it were finished.

t_strconc_wall_halfway.name: half-built reinforced concrete wall
t_strconc_wall_halfway.description: Poured concrete with methodically placed rebar sticking out, which isn't practical for supporting roofs or shelter.  It needs more resources before it could be considered complete.

t_reb_cage.name: rebar cage
t_reb_cage.description: A structural support system made of rebar that appears to be the early stages of a reinforced concrete wall, just missing the poured concrete.

t_scrap_wall.name: simple metal wall
t_scrap_wall.description: A relatively simple wall made of cobbled-together scrap metal.  It's still capable of blocking intruders and supporting a roof with adjacent walls.

t_scrap_wall_halfway.name: half-built simple metal wall
t_scrap_wall_halfway.description: A partially-built makeshift metal wall that could potentially support a roof if it were completed.

t_wall_wood_chipped.name: chipped wood wall
t_wall_wood_chipped.description: A wall of aligned planks that's starting to crack and break open.  Some replacement wood and a number of nails could patch this up quick.

t_wall_wood_broken.name: broken wood wall
t_wall_wood_broken.description: A number of planks are missing and the structure is beginning to sag and fall apart.  It's going to need quite a bit of work to repair.

t_wall_burnt.name: burnt wall
t_wall_burnt.description: Whatever this wall used to be made of, it's little more than charred remains now.

t_wall_log_half.name: half-built log wall
t_wall_log_half.description: A half-constructed wall of notched logs that interlock to provide stability.  Needs a few more logs to hold up a roof.  Looks flammable.

t_wall_log.name: log wall
t_wall_log.description: A tall wall of timber suitable for housing and insulating from the weather.  Quite flammable.

t_wall_log_chipped.name: chipped log wall
t_wall_log_chipped.description: A moderately damaged log wall, it could probably be patched up with some planks and nails.

t_wall_log_broken.name: broken log wall
t_wall_log_broken.description: A destroyed log wall, with only a supporting log left, ready to collapse.  Looks repairable if the damage was replaced and patched together with nails and planks.

t_palisade.name: palisade wall
t_palisade.description: An age-old type of fortification consisting of hefty lumber staked into the ground and cabled together.

t_wall_wattle.name: wattle-and-daub wall
t_wall_wattle.description: A relatively primitive wall made by daubing together a lattice of wooden strips using some combination of wet soil, clay, sand, animal dung, and straw.

t_wall_wattle_broken.name: broken wattle-and-daub wall
t_wall_wattle_broken.description: A wattle-and-daub wall section that has been destroyed, leaving mostly just the frame, and even that is barely held together.

t_wall_wattle_half.name: half-built wattle-and-daub wall
t_wall_wattle_half.description: A partially-complete wattle-and-daub wall with some of the wooden strip lattice in place.  It still requires the rest of the lattice and supporting wet compound to be filled in.

t_junk_wall.name: junk metal wall
t_junk_wall.description: A wall of rusty scrap metal bolted and wire-tied to a sturdy frame.  Very fashionable in post-apocalyptic shantytowns.  Can support a roof.

t_wall_rammed_earth.name: rammed earth wall
t_wall_rammed_earth.description: A solid wall of compressed dirt, sturdy enough to support a roof with enough walls and to keep out some unwanted visitors.

t_wall_dirt.name: smooth dirt wall
t_wall_dirt.description: A solid wall of compressed dirt, mixed with… something to keep it stable.  Its surface glistens slightly, and it smells like rotten milk.

t_wall_warped.name: warped wall
t_wall_warped.description: At first glance, this looks like a simple stone wall.  But the angles don't add up, and the shadows are wrong.  Whatever this is, it doesn't belong here.

t_junk_palisade.name: junk metal barrier
t_junk_palisade.description: A simple wall of rusty scrap metal bolted and wire-tied to a makeshift frame.  Very fashionable in post-apocalyptic shantytowns.  This one isn't quite strong enough to support a roof, but could be reinforced.

t_wall_glass.name: glass wall
t_wall_glass.description: A barrier made of glass, it's nothing complicated, and looks extremely fragile.  Some contain glass break sensors or window sensors that trigger an alarm if the glass is damaged.

t_wall_glass_alarm.name: glass wall
t_wall_glass_alarm.description: A barrier made of glass, it's nothing complicated, and looks extremely fragile.  Some contain glass break sensors or window sensors that trigger an alarm if the glass is damaged.

t_wall_glass_lab.name: glass wall
t_wall_glass_lab.description: A barrier made of glass, it's nothing complicated, and looks extremely fragile.  Some contain glass break sensors or window sensors that trigger an alarm if the glass is damaged.

t_laminated_glass.name: laminated glass
t_laminated_glass.description: A laminated glass barrier, composed of layers of glass and plastic held together by an interlayer.

t_ballistic_glass.name: ballistic glass
t_ballistic_glass.description: A ballistic glass barrier, consisting of layers of laminated glass.

t_reinforced_glass.name: reinforced glass
t_reinforced_glass.description: A thicker pane of glass with thin metal wires embedded throughout, strengthening the structural properties.  Still weaker than other types of walls, and not made to support a roof either.

t_reinforced_glass_lab.name: reinforced glass
t_reinforced_glass_lab.description: A thicker pane of glass with thin metal wires embedded throughout, strengthening the structural properties.  Still weaker than other types of walls, and not made to support a roof either.  Not the type of glass to stop a bullet, you realize.

t_reinforced_glass_shutter.name: reinforced glass with closed shutters
t_reinforced_glass_shutter.description: A secondary layer of protection over reinforced glass, these metal shutters are typically used to ward off criminals or protect against damage from extreme weather.  Looks like it can only be opened from the inside.  Even with the installed shutters, it isn't feasible in supporting a roof.

t_reinforced_glass_shutter_open.name: reinforced glass with open shutters
t_reinforced_glass_shutter_open.description: Hanging metal shutters that haven't been deployed, exposing the reinforced glass.  It appears as though the metal shutters can only be activated from the inside.

t_wall_lighthouse_lens.name: lighthouse lens
t_wall_lighthouse_lens.description: An intricate arrangement of glass, designed to focus light from within to be visible over long distances.

t_bars.name: metal bars
t_bars.description: Thick, heavy bars from the floor to the ceiling, interlaced wall to wall.  Not made to support roofs, but great for blocking paths.

t_paper.name: paper wall
t_paper.description: A huge wall of ambiguous pulpy matter, covered in sticky wasp saliva.  You could smash it down effortlessly.

t_paper_brood.name: paper wall
t_paper_brood.description: A huge wall of ambiguous pulpy matter, covered in sticky wasp saliva.  You could smash it down effortlessly.

t_paper_hard.name: layered paper wall
t_paper_hard.description: A thick wall of layered tree pulp and wasp saliva, hardened to withstand the elements.  You could break through this, but it won't be easy.

t_root_wall.name: root wall
t_root_wall.description: A dirt wall covered with roots.

t_wax.name: wax wall
t_wax.description: A wall made entirely out of wax.

t_rock.name: solid rock
t_rock.description: A wall of solid rock, could be full of all kinds of interesting things.  Best grab your pickaxe or equivalent digging implement, and strike the earth!

t_highland_bronze_pillar.name: gigantic bronze pillar
t_highland_bronze_pillar.description: A gigantic, monolithic pillar of bronze, stained green with age and crisscrossed with curved grooves.  The air around it feels heavy, and you get the distinct impression that this is not something you should be messing with.

t_column_halfway.name: half-built column
t_column_halfway.description: An empty wooden frame in the shape of a column, built around a concrete and rebar foundation.  It isn't capable of supporting roofs or shelter, and needs more resources before it could be considered complete.

t_highlands_conqueror_statue.name: statue of a conqueror
t_highlands_conqueror_statue.description: The regal countenance of this long-dead conqueror still gazes down upon the world, but only ruins remain of the empire they once built.

t_bollard.name: bollard
t_bollard.description: A set of concrete and steel bollards sticking out of the ground, designed to protect areas against vehicle ram attacks.  It requires a few more steps for you to walk between the bollards.

t_drystone_wall.name: field stone wall
t_drystone_wall.description: A sturdy, dry stone wall.  Just rocks fitted together without mortar.

t_drystone_wall_half.name: field stone half-wall
t_drystone_wall_half.description: A sturdy, half-height, dry stone wall.  Just rocks fitted together without mortar.

t_pillar.name: pillar
t_pillar.description: A concrete column that helps keep the mine's ceiling and walls from collapsing.

t_foam_wall.name: hardened resin mass
t_foam_wall.description: A mass of expansive foam that has hardened like a rock, tough enough to stop most zombies from breaking through.  It's big enough to walk on top of.

t_wood_sunshade_pole.name: wooden pole
t_wood_sunshade_pole.description: A wooden pole supporting a canvas sunshade.

t_window.description: A giant sheet of glass inserted into a window, typically found on the side of shops to showcase goods.

t_window_open.description: A window with fancy curtains on the inside that can be drawn closed to block visibility and shut out any light.  It's open and you can crawl through.

t_curtains.description: A closed window with fancy curtains that have been drawn shut, blocking sunlight and visibility.  The curtains can only be opened from the inside. t_window_empty_no_roof.name: empty window
t_window_empty_no_roof.description: An empty window frame made of planks and nails.  You could install a sheet of glass, or board it up for protection.  You could also convert it into a solid wall if you took the time to construct it.

t_window_empty.name: empty window
t_window_empty.description: An empty window frame made of planks and nails.  You could install a sheet of glass, or board it up for protection.  You could also convert it into a solid wall if you took the time to construct it.

t_window_empty_curtains_open.name: empty window with curtains
t_window_empty_curtains_open.description: An empty window frame consisting of planks and nails, with open curtains.  You could install a sheet of glass, or even board it up for protection.  You could also convert it into a wall if you took the time to construct it.

t_window_empty_curtains_closed.name: empty window with closed curtains
t_window_empty_curtains_closed.description: An empty window frame consisting of planks and nails, with closed curtains.  If you examined the curtains more closely, you could peek through the drapes or tear down everything.  You could install a sheet of glass, or even board it up for protection. t_window_frame.name: window frame
t_window_frame.description: A wooden window frame filled with shattered glass.  You'll probably get hurt if you crawl through the sharp and jagged shards.  You could smash out the remaining pieces, or take your time and quietly remove them.

t_window_empty_stone.name: empty window
t_window_empty_stone.description: An empty hole where once a window probably stood, now not even the frame remains.

t_window_boarded.name: boarded up window
t_window_boarded.description: A glass window that has been covered with nailed-down planks, blocking sunlight and visibility.  It's not much stronger, but it could be further reinforced with strategically placed planks.

prying.message: You pry the boards from the window.

t_window_boarded_noglass.name: boarded up window
t_window_boarded_noglass.description: An empty window frame that has been covered with nailed-down planks, blocking sunlight and visibility.  It's not a very strong barrier, but it could be further reinforced with strategically placed planks.

prying.message: You pry the boards from the window frame.

t_window_boarded_shutters_closed.name: window with makeshift shutters
t_window_boarded_shutters_closed.description: A glass window with a heavy makeshift shutter bolted into the window frame, with a wooden bar to close it from the inside.  It's fairly sturdy when closed.

t_window_boarded_shutters_open.name: window with open makeshift shutters
t_window_boarded_shutters_open.description: A glass window with a heavy makeshift shutter bolted into the window frame, with a wooden bar to close it from the inside.  The shutters are currently open, and offer no more defense than any glass window.

t_window_boarded_shutters_open_fully.name: window with open makeshift shutters
t_window_boarded_shutters_open_fully.description: A glass window with a heavy makeshift shutter bolted into the window frame, with a wooden bar to close it from the inside.  Both the shutters and the window glass are wide open, offering no defense.

t_window_reinforced.name: reinforced boarded up window
t_window_reinforced.description: A heavily fortified glass window with planks carefully placed across the glass to block vision.  Adding a few spikes and metal plating would further increase its durability.

t_window_reinforced_noglass.name: reinforced boarded up window
t_window_reinforced_noglass.description: A heavily fortified window with planks carefully placed across the open frame to block vision.  Adding a few spikes and metal plating would further increase its durability.

t_window_enhanced.name: armored boarded up window
t_window_enhanced.description: This once-normal glass window now menaces with spikes along the edges, with laboriously placed metal sheeting to further strengthen the wooden reinforcements underneath.

t_window_enhanced_noglass.name: armored boarded up window
t_window_enhanced_noglass.description: This once-normal window frame now menaces with spikes along the edges, with laboriously placed metal sheeting to further strengthen the wooden reinforcements underneath.

t_window_bars.name: window with metal bars
t_window_bars.description: A giant sheet of glass inserted into a window with thick security grilles, making it impossible to crawl through.  Typically installed in high-value stores, or ones in bad neighborhoods.

t_window_bars_noglass.name: window frame with metal bars
t_window_bars_noglass.description: A window frame blocked with thick security grilles, making it impossible to crawl through.  Typically installed in high-value stores, or ones in bad neighborhoods.

t_window_bars_alarm.name: window with metal bars
t_window_bars_alarm.description: A giant sheet of glass inserted into a window with thick security grilles, making it impossible to crawl through.  Typically installed in high-value stores, or ones in bad neighborhoods.  It has a small sticker in one corner, reading 'Protected by SecuriCorp.  Keeping you safe since 1993.'

t_window_bars_curtains.name: window with metal bars and curtains
t_window_bars_curtains.description: A barred window with fancy curtains that have been drawn shut, blocking sunlight and visibility.  The curtains can only be opened from the inside.  If you examined the curtains more closely, you could peek through the drapes or tear down everything.

t_window_bars_domestic.name: window with metal bars and curtains
t_window_bars_domestic.description: A giant sheet of glass inserted into a window with thick security grilles, making it impossible to crawl through.  Typically installed in high-value stores, or ones in bad neighborhoods.  This one has been retrofitted with curtains, which are currently open.

t_window_stained_green.name: stone wall with high stained glass window
t_window_stained_green.description: A stone wall with a high window containing breathtaking craftsmanship of stained glass featuring an elegant emerald landscape.

t_window_stained_red.name: stone wall with high stained glass window
t_window_stained_red.description: A stone wall with a high window containing breathtaking craftsmanship of stained glass featuring an otherworldly radiant ruby flower blooming.

t_window_stained_blue.name: high stained glass window
t_window_stained_blue.description: A stone wall with a high window containing breathtaking craftsmanship of stained glass featuring an alluring azure oceanic abyss.

t_metal_grate_window.name: window with metal grate
t_metal_grate_window.description: Metal bars made into a grate for a glass window.  Highly durable and will stand against any foe.

t_metal_grate_window_with_curtain.name: window with metal grate and curtains
t_metal_grate_window_with_curtain.description: Metal bars made into a grate for a glass window with a closed curtain.  Highly durable and will stand against any foe.

t_metal_grate_window_with_curtain_open.name: window with metal grate and curtains
t_metal_grate_window_with_curtain_open.description: Metal bars made into a grate for a glass window with an opened curtain.  Highly durable and will stand against any foe.

t_single_pane_glass_open.description: A single glazed window.  Consists of a giant sheet of glass inserted into a window frame.  It's open and can be crawled through.
